rationale: For the current official Hermes Desktop path, AOTA Profile Task completion is durably readable by task-main but is not automatically delivered to or used to wake the Hermes parent session. If automatic wake is a hard requirement, the smallest missing cross-system boundary is a minimal backend hook, likely fed by the existing sanitized AOTA outbox; it is not proven that a direct native API can consume AOTA records.

options.name: direct Hermes native delivery API
options.required_changes: AOTA would need native delegation record/queue ownership and profile/session routing
options.security_risk: high unless native ownership validation is reused

options.name: AOTA plugin adapter
options.required_changes: finish and integrate the existing outbox adapter with a trusted current Desktop/backend boundary
options.offline_support: outbox pending files, reconnect drain not yet proven
options.security_risk: manageable with origin validation and sanitization
options.recommended: only if WebUI/bridge boundary is explicitly retained

options.name: minimal Hermes backend hook
options.required_changes: small trusted hook that consumes validated AOTA terminal events and routes to the correct live parent/profile without restoring old WebUI wholesale
options.plugin_change_required: outbox producer already exists; adapter contract may need alignment
options.security_risk: requires trusted source, ownership and profile checks

options.name: no automatic wakeup; task-main reads result
options.required_changes: none for delivery; use receipt/meta/handoff/result artifact status APIs

options.name: insufficient evidence
options.required_changes: live smoke would add confidence but is not needed to establish the source-level gap

next_work_item: If automatic wake is required, scope HOST-WI-03B as a narrow adapter/backend-boundary design; do not restore legacy WebUI whole-file overlays.
